title: Hello
subtitle: Carsharing
summary: Hello is a carsharing service in Warsaw. As Head of Marketing I ran its whole marketing end to end - brand, design, content, shoots, ads, partnerships and events.
task: Make a young carsharing brand known and trusted in the city, grow app installs and first rides, and make every launch - a new car, tariff or promo - impossible to miss.
role: Head of Marketing. I led the whole marketing function: strategy and budgets, brand and design, print, SMM and video, shoots, UGC, paid social, Google Ads, collaborations, events and reporting.
approach: Every channel in one pair of hands. Each launch got its own content, design, ad campaign and partner activity, so Hello looked and sounded the same in the app, on social media, on the street and on the cars.
scope: Marketing strategy - yearly and launch plans, channel mix, budgets and KPIs, reporting on results
Positioning and tone of voice - how Hello speaks in the app, on social media, in ads and on the street
Brand identity - logo system, company brandbook and app brandbook, templates for every channel
Graphic and print design - flyers, posters, stickers, outdoor, event branding, merch and the car wrap
SMM - content strategy and calendar for Instagram and TikTok, daily posting and community management
Short-form video - ideas, scripts and hooks, shooting and editing Reels and TikToks, talking-head videos with me on camera
Shoot production - concepts, shot lists, locations, cars, crew and the whole shoot day from call time to wrap
UGC and creators - finding bloggers and creators, briefs, approvals and reusing their content in ads
Paid social - Meta and TikTok campaigns for every launch, audiences, creatives, tests and optimisation
Search and context ads - Google Ads campaigns, keywords and conversion tracking
Collaborations - finding partners, pitching and negotiating, joint promos with Burger King, McDonald's, Tokiny, Westmotors, banks and 20+ brands
Media and radio - campaigns on Radio Unistar and Radio Mir
Events - car shows Avtozhara and Green Cars Day, charity trips, the road rally with Tochka, from idea to the booth on site
Website and app - website concept, logic and support, app store pages and in-app visuals
3D mascot - character, poses and animated shorts for the app, website and social media
Analytics - ad reports, install and ride growth, cost per click and per install
Contractors - briefing and managing designers, editors, photographers, printers and partner agencies
